column1: # Code in .text that Database/Tools/work/graph/functions.tsv does not list.
# Derived by taking the span of the 34,270 non-funclet listed bodies, subtracting those
# bodies, removing int3 padding, and splitting what is left on int3 runs at 16-byte
# alignment.  That splitter was scored first against 28,368 KNOWN bodies in 400
# all-padding stretches: precision 0.984, recall 0.926.  It therefore UNDER-counts
# boundaries by roughly 7% and invents about 2%, and neither error is corrected here.
# 1,471 blocks, 244,619 bytes.  576 of them are under 16 bytes and hold 5,271 bytes
# between them; the 32 blocks of 1 KiB or more hold 166,485.
# A row is a code RUN, not a proven function entry.  See
# the-code-the-function-list-does-not-contain.md for what is and is not claimed.
